name: jev-decision-layer
description: Jev Decision Layer — typed judgment tools (route/check/review/guard). Returns decisions only; never executes actions.

JEV_API_KEY.title: Jev / TypeSafe API key
JEV_API_KEY.description: Bearer key (jv_live_… or TypeSafe console key). Also accepts TYPESAFE_API_KEY at runtime.

JEV_BASE_URL.title: API base URL override
JEV_BASE_URL.description: OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai/api (or …/api/v1/systemone). Leave empty for TypeSafe/Jev hosts.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.title: OpenRouter API key
OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Required when JEV_BASE_URL points at openrouter.ai (sk-or-…). Billed to OpenRouter.
